_note: Name-facts for Uganda (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region
of the same id, written later, never shows a town's sentences.

en: Its name is often read as "hill of the impala".
Like Rome, it was first built on seven hills.
it: Il nome si legge spesso come "collina dell’impala".
Come Roma, fu costruita dapprima su sette colli.
